verdict.rationale: Sift documents Review Queues and human-in-the-loop decisioning (sift-docs-12, sift-comm-4) but there is no evidence of any agent-facing API, MCP server, or tool that lets an AI agent pull flagged cases, summarize evidence, or draft a recommended decision for human confirmation. The llms.txt probe shows only a generic marketing overview, not an agentic review-queue interface. Missing for 10: an agent-accessible API/MCP tool for the review queue, evidence of case summarization or recommendation generation, and any documented human-confirm workflow for agent-proposed decisions.
